plot-title: Sums and differences of the prompt directions
plot-caption: The cosine of the sum (left) and the difference (right) of 2 prompt directions with each single prompt direction, at the noun token, as a mean over the saved layers, for 3 models. A prompt direction is the unit vector of the r over the 197 NTAs of each lens word's NTA mean readout with the prompt's answer margin. Rows: the 21 pairs of the 7 adjectives; columns: the 7 single directions of each model. A grey cell is a member of its pair. Values of .5 or more are printed.
